fusions.name: Fetch the Barb
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. You bite down for 9 damage and leave the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rip Free
fusions.desc: A tearing bite that deals 16 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.8 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Reel Them In
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 3 enemies within 5 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Tug of War
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, you regain 6 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
